cues: Welcome to Class 12 Physics, Unit 12: Diffraction.
Light bends round obstacles and spreads after passing through narrow openings.
It is Huygens' wavelets interfering with one another.
It limits every telescope and microscope ever built, and it powers the diffraction grating, our most accurate way to measure wavelength.
